scope: Conditional original-JP replay with supplied high FREEFALL/live large box and timed shell placement; no ground action supplied. On-screen visual commentary plus original instrumental music. G = Stored Graphics (gfx.pos), not rendered pose.

segments.title: A live box creates the slide
lines: This time, Mario starts airborne. The game creates DIVE_SLIDE.
A later shell shove completes Ink and changes the Area 2 spawn.
segments.footer: High Mario, the live box and the shell placement are supplied. This is not a complete gameplay route.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: What the test supplies
lines: Mario is supplied in FREEFALL at Y 25001, with eastward speed 32.
The large box is live at Y 24800. Its solid top reaches Y 25000.
segments.footer: Left: paused replay after update 1. Right: initial setup diagram. Shell availability is also supplied.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: One unit outside the edge
lines: Mario starts at X -1950. The west edge of the box is X -1949.
The next air-step candidate crosses the edge and encounters its floor.
segments.footer: Mario and box share Z -939. This diagram shows collision coordinates, not the rendered model.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: B makes a dive; landing makes a slide
lines: Press B once, with neutral stick. A remains released.
FREEFALL enters DIVE, then the landing result selects DIVE_SLIDE.
segments.footer: No ground action is written into Mario. All inputs after this B press are neutral.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: The landing keeps the low cache
lines: The high box floor triggers LANDED, but the clearance test rejects X/Z.
Mario gets the high Y while his earlier low floor cache stays at 768.
segments.footer: Default no-ceiling height 20000 minus floor 25000 is not greater than 160; no physical ceiling is needed.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: High slide, still outside the box
lines: M, C and G all have Y 25000. The action is now DIVE_SLIDE.
X remains -1950, outside the box. This is not ordinary standing on top.
segments.footer: Cache 768; no platform. G means Stored Graphics (gfx.pos), not the visibly rendered pose.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: Now supply only the shell position
lines: Place the shell at (-1971, 25000, -939), then give neutral input.
Mario is not edited again. The large box stays live and fixed.
segments.footer: The shell is never held, used or ridden in the observed suffix. Its job here is a fallback contact shove.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: A sideways shove preserves the slide
lines: A fresh floor lookup keeps 768. Contact pushes Mario 68 units east.
The nonmounting shell shove reaches the slide and floor-alignment code.
segments.footer: The shell supplies the shove; the live box already supplied the landing result that created the action.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: Store high graphics, then snap movement
lines: The stopped ground step saves high movement into G: Stored Graphics.
Floor alignment then snaps movement Y to the cached low floor.
segments.footer: This is an immediate store and snap, not a visible fall of 24232 units.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: The producer has made Ink
lines: Movement and collision are now (-1882, 768, -939).
Stored Graphics is (-1882, 25000, -939): a 24232-unit Y gap.
segments.footer: The action ends as GROUND_BONK; alignment has run. On the next update, the box mesh unloads by distance.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: Low contact, high floor retry
lines: Low collision contacts the real upper warp. The failed floor lookup retries at G.
The spinning top is loaded now, so the retry selects its surface.
segments.footer: The high live box mesh is no longer loaded. This is a floor query at Stored Graphics, not a high warp.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: The top becomes the platform
lines: The warp is accepted. Floor owner and platform both name the spinning top.
M, C and G reunite at Y 1818.9613 while Mario is DISAPPEARED.
segments.footer: Used warp: slot 64. Captured platform: top slot 61. A position gap alone would not establish this.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: The reference survives the countdown
lines: The recorded Area 1 samples keep the top as Mario's platform.
Its inactive reference remains at the last observed Area 1 boundary.
segments.footer: This section advances through joined native images; each is held longer than one game update.
segments.badge: A released throughout / annotated original JP replay

segments.title: Two transition observations are missing
lines: Native step 27 records the inactive top and retained platform.
Steps 28 and 29 have no camera observations; we do not fill them in.
segments.footer: Left: paused native step 26. Wafel separately records continuous retention through the transition.

lines: The first Area 2 position is (365.593, 5500, -1096.803).
That differs from the ordinary warp spawn (0, 5500, 256).

segments.title: The original replay continues
lines: The camera reveals the arrival while the recorded neutral inputs continue.
The comparison arrow marks two spawn locations, not a travelled path.

segments.title: A frozen clone did not replace the floor
segments.tag: SEPARATE WAFEL CONTROL / NOT SHOWN AS ROM FOOTAGE
lines: A supplied frozen carry-script box loads no high solid mesh and fails to land.
Moving raw object XYZ does not, by itself, rebuild collision triangles there.
segments.footer: The working box stays live. High delivery by gameplay remains unresolved; no general clone impossibility is proved.
segments.badge: Paused success image / not the failed clone control

segments.title: A real action predecessor; delivery is open
lines: One original-JP positive creates the ground slide and useful displacement.
Getting Mario, a live high box and the timed shell here through play is still open.
segments.footer: 27 supplied writes. 1035/1080 compared components match; 45 subtype differences remain. No new Coq theorem.
